## Description

Solves Nash equilibrium portfolio allocation strategies for continuous-time asset management where fund managers compete against benchmark average fund performance.

## Where it may fit

Competitive institutional fund management, relative performance benchmarking, crowded trade environments.

## Vehicles

Institutional Mutual Funds, Pension Funds, Multi-Manager Hedge Funds.

## Required data

Cross-sectional asset returns, benchmark peer allocation estimates, asset volatility matrices.

## Caveats

Coupled Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) and Fokker-Planck-Kolmogorov (FPK) equations require high-dimensional PDE solvers.
